text: Eight canonical operators: ◇ Essence, ↔ Mirror, ∞ Bridge, ◎ Rift, α AXI, Σ Seal, ℜ Ripple, ℘ Weakest-Voice.

Three new concepts for the Ripple operator: recipe (reproducible method of propagation), adaptations (ordered sequence of mutations), season (macro-pacing rhythm — the felt time of giving and receiving).

P#0080 — 'He who gives a drop, multiplies the ripples.' This is both the governing proverb of the Ripple operator AND the final line of the entire 3,333-proverb canon. The schema implements the canon's last word.
